config.title: Component Composition

intro.title: Component Composition
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple user profile card by combining multiple Vue components. You will learn component composition, which is the practice of building larger, reusable interfaces by nesting smaller components. The main technologies involved are Vue single-file components, props for passing data, and template structure. By the end, you will understand how to structure and connect components to create modular and maintainable Vue applications.
intro.usecase: Component composition is fundamental to building scalable Vue applications like e-commerce platforms, where you compose product cards, filters, and shopping carts into cohesive pages. In admin dashboards, you combine reusable charts, data tables, and control panels to create complex interfaces efficiently. This pattern allows developers to assemble modular UI blocks—like forms with input groups, validation messages, and submit buttons—without rewriting code. By mastering composition, you can construct maintainable features such as nested navigation menus or modal dialogs with consistent behavior across an application.

objectives: Construct a parent component that imports and renders child components
Configure props to pass data from parent components to child components
Implement event listeners to handle child component emissions in parent components
Apply slots to compose flexible content structures between components
Integrate dynamic components using Vue's built-in <component> element
Manipulate component composition patterns to build reusable UI structures
Initialize and bind component instances with proper data flow patterns

steps.title: Import Vue and createApp
steps.instruction: Import Vue and createApp from the 'vue' package.
steps.hint: Use the import statement to bring in the necessary functions from Vue.
steps.analogousExample:
// Importing functions from a library
import { createApp } from 'vue'
steps.expectedOutcome: The Vue and createApp functions are imported and ready to use.
successCriteria: Vue and createApp are imported from 'vue'.
steps.feedbackCorrect: Nice! Proceed to the next step.
steps.feedbackPartial: You've imported something, but make sure you're importing both Vue and createApp from 'vue'.
steps.feedbackWrong: The import statement is missing or incorrect. You need to import Vue and createApp from the 'vue' package.

steps.title: Create the main App component
steps.instruction: Create a Vue component named App that returns a template with a div container.
steps.hint: Define a component function that returns a template with a div element.
steps.seedCode:
// Import Vue and createApp from 'vue'

// Create the App component here
steps.expectedOutcome: The App component is defined with a template containing a div container.
successCriteria: App component is defined and returns a template with a div element.
steps.feedbackCorrect: Nice! Proceed to the next step.
steps.feedbackPartial: You're close. Make sure the App component returns a template with a div element.
steps.feedbackWrong: The App component should be defined with a template containing a div container.

steps.title: Create a child component (Greeting)
steps.instruction: Create a new Vue component named Greeting that accepts a 'name' prop and returns a paragraph element displaying 'Hello, [name]!'
steps.hint: Define a new component function that takes props as a parameter and returns a template with the greeting message.
steps.expectedOutcome: A Greeting component is defined that will display personalized greetings when used with different name props.
successCriteria: Greeting component is defined with a name prop and returns a paragraph containing 'Hello, [name]!'
steps.feedbackCorrect: Nice! Proceed to the next step.
steps.feedbackPartial: You've created a component, but make sure it accepts a 'name' prop and displays 'Hello, [name]!' in a paragraph.
steps.feedbackWrong: The Greeting component isn't defined correctly. Create a component that takes a name prop and returns a greeting message.

steps.title: Register the child component in App
steps.instruction: In the App component's options object, add a 'components' property and register the Greeting component.
steps.hint: The components option is an object where keys are the names you'll use in templates and values are the imported components.
steps.expectedOutcome: The App component will have access to the Greeting component for use in its template.
successCriteria: The App component has a components property with Greeting registered.
steps.feedbackCorrect: Nice! Proceed to the next step.
steps.feedbackPartial: You're close. Make sure you've added the components property with Greeting inside it.
steps.feedbackWrong: The Greeting component isn't registered yet. Add a components property to the App component object.

steps.title: Add data to App component
steps.instruction: In the App component, add a data function that returns an object with a userName property set to 'Vue Learner'.
steps.hint: In Vue, components can have a data option that is a function returning an object with reactive properties.
steps.expectedOutcome: The App component will have reactive data that can be used in its template.
successCriteria: App component has a data function returning an object with userName property set to 'Vue Learner'.
steps.feedbackCorrect: Great! You've added reactive data to the App component.
steps.feedbackPartial: You're close. Make sure the data function returns an object with a userName property.
steps.feedbackWrong: The App component needs a data function returning an object with a userName property.

steps.title: Use the Greeting component in App template
steps.instruction: In the App component's template, add the Greeting component as a child element.
steps.hint: Place the Greeting component inside the div in the template string.
steps.expectedOutcome: The App component's template will contain the Greeting component, demonstrating parent-child composition.
successCriteria: The Greeting component is placed inside the div in App's template string.
steps.feedbackCorrect: Nice! Proceed to the next step.
steps.feedbackPartial: You're close. Make sure the Greeting component is placed inside the div in App's template string.
steps.feedbackWrong: The Greeting component should be added to App's template. Look at the analogous example for guidance.

steps.title: Create a second child component (ButtonCounter)
steps.instruction: Create a new component named ButtonCounter that will track its own count and have a method to increment it.
steps.hint: Define a constant called ButtonCounter with an object containing a data function and a method.
steps.expectedOutcome: A ButtonCounter component is defined with its own reactive data and increment method.
successCriteria: ButtonCounter component exists with a data function returning count and an increment method.
steps.feedbackCorrect: Nice! Proceed to the next step.
steps.feedbackPartial: You've started the ButtonCounter component, but make sure it has both a data function and an increment method.
steps.feedbackWrong: The ButtonCounter component is not properly defined. Check that it has a data function and an increment method.

steps.title: Register ButtonCounter in App
steps.instruction: In the App component, add ButtonCounter to the components option alongside Greeting.
steps.hint: The components option should be an object with component names as keys and component definitions as values. Add ButtonCounter as a key.
steps.expectedOutcome: The App component's components option now includes both Greeting and ButtonCounter components.
successCriteria: ButtonCounter is registered as a component in App's components option.
steps.feedbackCorrect: Nice! Proceed to the next step.
steps.feedbackPartial: You're close. Make sure ButtonCounter is added to the components object in App.
steps.feedbackWrong: ButtonCounter is not registered in App. Check that you've added it to the components option.

steps.title: Add ButtonCounter to App template
steps.instruction: In the App component's template, add the ButtonCounter component alongside the existing Greeting component.
steps.hint: You can add the ButtonCounter component using its tag name <ButtonCounter /> within the template string.
steps.expectedOutcome: The App template now includes both Greeting and ButtonCounter components, demonstrating composition of multiple independent components.
successCriteria: ButtonCounter component is included in the App template alongside Greeting.
steps.feedbackCorrect: Nice! Proceed to the next step.
steps.feedbackPartial: You're close. Make sure you've added the ButtonCounter component to the App template.
steps.feedbackWrong: The ButtonCounter component is not yet included in the App template. Try adding it within the template string.

steps.title: Mount the App to the DOM
steps.instruction: Use createApp to mount the App component to an element with id 'app' in the DOM.
steps.hint: Call createApp with the App component as argument, then call its mount method with the CSS selector '#app'.
steps.expectedOutcome: The Vue application is mounted to the DOM, making the components render in the browser.
successCriteria: createApp is called with App and the mount method is called with '#app'.
steps.feedbackCorrect: Nice! Proceed to the next step.
steps.feedbackPartial: You're close. Make sure you're calling both createApp with the App component and mount with '#app'.
steps.feedbackWrong: The app isn't mounted correctly. Check that you're using createApp and mount with the right arguments.
